data.current_description:
Retrieve results for a job. Every POST /v1/properties request is asynchronous: it returns a job_id with status "processing" immediately. Poll this endpoint every 10-15 seconds until status is "complete" or "failed" (each poll counts as a request). **Prefer `webhook_url` on the original request over polling** — you get one callback the moment the job finishes instead of running a poll loop.

**CSV export**: add `?format=csv` to download the successful properties as a flat spreadsheet (one row per property, ~42 columns) once the job is complete. While the job is still processing or has failed, the JSON status is returned regardless of `format`, so existing poll loops keep working. Nested fields (price_history, tax_history, nearby_schools, comps) are emitted as JSON strings in single cells; feature lists are joined with "; ".

**Ownership**: results are only readable by the API key that submitted the job. Any other key gets 404, identical to an unknown job_id.
data.summary_suggestion: Poll or retrieve property data job results
data.description_suggestion: Retrieve results for an asynchronous property data job submitted via POST /v1/properties. Returns job status (processing, complete, or failed) and property results once complete. Supports JSON response (default) or CSV export via ?format=csv query parameter. Results are only accessible by the API key that submitted the original request. Polling is recommended every 10-15 seconds, though webhook_url on the original request is preferred to avoid polling overhead.

data.current_description:
Get detailed property data from Zillow. Accepts five input types -- use any combination:

- **search**: Free-text query like "Los Angeles" or "Miami Beach FL"
- **zipcodes**: Array of US ZIP codes like [90210, 90211]
- **zpids**: Array of Zillow Property IDs like [20794780]
- **addresses**: Street addresses like "123 Main St, City, ST 12345"
- **urls**: Zillow listing URLs or search page URLs

**Filters** (all optional):
- **type**: Listing status — sale, rent, sold, fsbo, all (default). Works on its own for zipcodes searches — no need to also set property_type.
- **property_type**: house, condo, townhouse, land, apartment, manufactured, multi_family
- **price_min** / **price_max**: Price range in USD, applied at the search level

**Per-request limit**: Every request returns at most your plan's limit, for all input types: Basic 5, Pro 10, Ultra 25, Mega 50 properties. `max_items` above the limit is lowered to it; more addresses/zpids/urls than the limit returns 400. To cover more listings, split by ZIP code, property type, or price range and make one request per slice.

All requests are **async** for maximum speed. Returns a job_id instantly (under 100ms). Poll GET /v1/results/{job_id} every 10-15 seconds until status is complete, or set `webhook_url` to skip polling and get a callback when the job finishes. Results typically ready in 3-10 seconds for small batches, up to ~60s for 200+ properties. Results are only readable by the API key that submitted the job.
data.summary_suggestion: Search Zillow properties and retrieve detailed data
data.description_suggestion: Submit an asynchronous request to retrieve 50+ fields of detailed property data from Zillow. Accepts multiple input types: free-text search queries, ZIP codes, Zillow Property IDs (zpids), street addresses, or Zillow URLs. Optional filters include listing status (sale, rent, sold, fsbo), property type (house, condo, townhouse, etc.), and price range. Returns a job_id immediately; results are available via GET /v1/results/{job_id}. Per-request limit depends on plan (Basic 5, Pro 10, Ultra 25, Mega 50 properties). Results typically available in 3-10 seconds for small batches, up to 60 seconds for larger requests. Use webhook_url to receive a callback when complete instead of polling.
